title: Proximal single atoms for stable electrocatalysts - Nature Materials
html:
Ru–O–Cr motifs atomically dispersed in proximity on a MnO2 substrate effectively suppress oxidation-induced Ru dissolution with enhanced catalyst durability towards the oxygen evolution reaction in acidic water electrolysers.
